description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_CSS_ListStyle, which validates the shorthand CSS property 'list-style'. It processes input strings to ensure they conform to expected values for list-style-type, list-style-position, and list-style-image, and constructs a combined value if valid.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_CSS_ListStyle
classes.description: A class that validates shorthand CSS property 'list-style', composed of type, position, and image components.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the validator by extracting relevant info from the CSS definition.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates and parses the list-style CSS shorthand string into its components, returning a string with the combined value or false if invalid.
